note: Making at camp (docs/future/13 sections 3.12 and 6; S1, October 24, 2026; S2 and P2j, October 25). Read by src/world/camp/making.js (pure) and src/world/camp/stations.js (live). A make's parts are what is laid on a station's surface, one handful each; nothing is taken until its action is pressed, and then each handful comes from the pack first, then the camp's piles, then the hamper (P2j). Tier is for the docs and labs only: the code checks parts and what is already made, never a tier.
buildsNote: Things built in their own camp slot, the way the ring is laid (CS-05): the slot glows while the pack (or a pile at camp, or the hamper) holds the parts and you are near camp, once the ring is laid (afterRing); its card offers Build; the walker plays act at the slot and the parts leave. parts: [kind, handfuls] pairs. The first build is written on the camp page. The apothecary bench (S2) is lashed from sticks with rush cord, so it waits for cord.

src: October 29, 2026 (Matt): the first shovel's haft before any bush gives sticks

lilyParcelNote: October 27, 2026 (Matt): the turtles' made treat. A handful of worms wrapped in a lily leaf picked in summer and tied with rush cord, one parcel; set by a basking spot at the water's edge, the turtles tear at it together (recipes/species/turtle.json treat).
seedBallsNote: P2g G5: a handful of clay and a handful of any plant's saved seed ({ part: 'seed' } takes any '<species>.seed'; its pencil outline wears thrift seed) roll into a handful of seed balls of that species (gives '{sp}.ball', the laid seed's species). Each ball sows a cluster of three on slightly poorer ground (sowing.json ball).
carriersNote: P2f: the rush satchel (a handful of rushes or marram plaited, two of cord for its strap) and the willow basket (a handful of withies woven, two of cord for its straps), out 'carrier': put on at once in place of the carrier worn, which hangs at camp (recipes/world/pack.json wear, hang). Their parts never tie with the hamper's (two rushes, one cord) or the rack's (two withies or sticks, one cord): with one of each laid, the make using all three wins.
makesNote: Every make at a station. at: the station (workbench, fire, apothecary); act: its action's icon and label (words.acts), else the station's own; parts: one handful each, a kind id, a list of kinds that serve (['sticks', 'drift-twigs']), or any kind of a pack group ({ group: 'herbs', shows: the kind its pencil outline wears }); after: a camp slot that must be built first (the mortar and rack wait for the apothecary bench, the second hamper for the first, Dry for the rack, Grind for the mortar); out: where it goes when made ('tool' hangs on the pack and takes no pouch, kept in the cook section's tools; 'pouch' fills a pouch of gives, count handfuls, or a small heap at your feet when the pack is full; 'slot' stands in its camp slot (slot), carried there; 'stack' stacks a second hamper on the first, 6 slots to 12; 'rack' hangs the herb on the drying rack as a bunch); max: how many can ever be made (the station stops offering it). Rush cord (P2c): one handful of rushes or marram leaves twisted into one handful of cord. The shovel needs a stick, a flat stone and cord. The drying rack: two withies or sticks lashed with cord; the mortar: a flat stone hollowed with a pebble. The hamper (P2j): two handfuls of rushes coiled and stitched with cord; the second hamper takes rushes, cord and a willow-withy lid. Dry hangs a handful of any herb on the rack; Grind turns a handful of broken shells into crushed shell (Mix waits for P2e). willow-charcoal (P2i, X-15): a handful of withies laid at the fire with Fire goes on the overnight work list (out 'work', src/world/camp/work.js): after needH game hours of fire, lit or banked, it is a full pouch (count handfuls) of charcoal sticks, taken up from the ring's card. work.max: the most pieces laid at the fire at once. leaf-pack (P2h): a handful of fallen leaves bound with rush cord into one leaf pack, the minnows' treat (recipes/world/treats.json). One make is shown at a time: the one with the most parts laid, then the lower tier, then this file's order.
shapedNote: Clay pieces shaped at the workbench (S5) wait pale on its slab, at most max at once, until each is laid at the fire with Fire (makes fire-<kind>: the part 'shaped:<kind>' is laid from the workbench's row in the fire's workspace). Fired after needH game hours of fire, lit or banked, on the overnight work list (work.js); never cracks, never fails. A fired pot or the cup goes to its own slot at the ring's side (camp.json hearth.slots; the first pot onto empty hearth stones); a fired bowl waits at the ring's edge until taken up from the ring's card into a bowl pouch.
makeSNote: How long the walker works at the station for a make (real seconds), kneeling at the bench: figure.json gestures.make. The thing is made as it ends.
nothingHoldSNote: Parts that make nothing together stay on the surface this long (real seconds) with the calm line, then go back to their pouches.
boonsNote: Tea boons (P2e, approved October 25, 2026). Keys are teas.herbs names, a blend's two joined by + in either order. h: game hours on the island it lasts (it counts down only while you are there, never in time away). walk: walk speed; trust: every trust gain (read by trust.js and swarms.js); comfort: a creature's comfort ring (0.9 lets you 10% closer before it shies); sight: how far finds and gather spots show; dig: dig time; make: make time at the stations; burn: how long the fire burns on its fuel; handful: the chance (seeded) of an extra handful at each gather; reveal: an unfound creature gives itself away once, a call or a ripple. dried: how many of the two herbs must come dried off the rack. rest: Deep rest gives no lift itself; rest in the tent while it lasts and you wake with these two herbs' boons together for after's h. A key with after: a boon only that blend gives on waking, never brewed. Boons lift the walker and the walker's friendships, never growth or the land.
teasNote: Brewing at the tea pot (P2e). herbs: each tea herb's short name and the pack kind it is. strength: the order that decides any other pair (the stronger herb's single boon, with a taste line the first time). steepS: real seconds the pot steeps after Brew (steam rises); sipS: real seconds the walker sits and sips (figure.json gestures.sip). left: the HUD's word for how much is left, by share (words.teaLeft).
mealNote: The walker's meal (docs/future/15 slice 4; src/world/camp/cookpot.js): the cooking pot on the hearth, full of spring water over a lit fire, is a workspace with two spots: an egg (parts) and, if there is some, a pinch of salt. Cook takes them and the water; the walker kneels to watch it boil (cookS), then sits by the fire to eat (eatS). Its boon (boons.meal, one at a time like the teas) begins, and the shells go into the pack (gives). With salt it is the good breakfast; without, a plain boiled egg (the salt pans are their own piece). The first meal writes a camp-page first (cook made 'meal') and a journal line.

wordsNote: Every line the stations and the camp page say. <slot>Slot: a bench's ground card (name, line, needs, and its Build label); builtLines: the line after a build other than the workbench's (built). acts: the apothecary's actions. hamper: the stations' row of what the hamper holds; takeUp, setDownHere, emptySlot: the hamper's and the rack's cards. made: the line after a first make, by make id. workFull, workTake, workWaiting, workDone: the overnight work at the fire (the ring's card). pageNames, pageParts: the camp page's first-made lines, in the walker's hand: name, what it was made of, and the date.
